The map follows the §10.5.2 blueprint and every icon is on its exact §10.5.3 cell. The peninsula joins the continent only through the drawbridge (42,40..43), which is sea until prologue_done. The continent is one ring around the inner sea, closed by 潮見橋 at (88..91,74); the checker confirms every place stays reachable when any one ring region is closed. マレア諸島 and ビブリア島 can only be reached by ferry. There are roads between all towns, three rivers with bridges, and 4 tiles of sea at every edge so the wrap seam is open water.

All 9 §10.5.6 story tile changes are in, and none of them changes which places can be reached. Dovan's valley opens only to the south-west, so the tunnel through (70..80,20) that opens after r_mine cuts Dovan to Orbis from 57 to 40 steps. There are 75 zone rectangles for the ten zw_* zones, with zw_forest as the default. The three hidden passages lead to visible chests world_c1 (p_gear), world_c2 (p_gold) and world_c3 (p_rare); each chest can only be reached through its passage.

I checked the look with the real A16a art: 3 whole-map views and 9 in-game views, over several rounds of fixes. In the running game I confirmed the raised drawbridge and its message, entering the hidden passage and opening its chest, and the minimap.

No part of BRIEF Part A contradicts DESIGN in this area. Where I departed from DESIGN:

- For ports and the mine I used the optional icons §11.2.3 permits: loc_port for lute, loch, coral and biblia, and loc_mine for deep_mine. The icon column of the §10.5.3 table could be updated.
- §10.6.4 lists the lighthouse_2 hidden passage under world, but §13.1 moved the lighthouse maps to A18b, so it is theirs. The roa NPC slots of §10.10.1 are theirs for the same reason.

_impl_A4.summary:
A4 field is finished and passes its own checks. node tools/test_field.js: 349 checks in 14 sections, 0 failed (24,249 frames, about 1 s), including the Part A6 acceptance tests W1-W4. node tools/build.js --check passes. validate.js and check_text.js report no errors for A4 files (other owners still have errors there). I found no DESIGN-vs-BRIEF conflict in my area; BRIEF A3 adds one thing DESIGN 2.3 omits (a townsperson who cannot step aside swaps places with the party), and I kept it.

Likely cause of the Crest freeze after a wipe (城で復活したあと固まる): R.UI.say reuses an open message window and overwrites the pending resolve of an earlier say. When the respawn town's onEnter speech and the game-over wake-up line overlap, the speech's promise never settles, R.Events.busy() stays true, and the field is frozen. I fixed it on the field side (the town's onEnter is held back until R.GameOver.run() has finished and then runs exactly once) and ask the lead to fix it in ui.js and add it to DESIGN 4.12.2.

Files: src/systems/{field,field_map,events_runtime,minimap,debug}.js, tools/test_field.js, tools/check_field.js, tools/fixtures/field/fx_maps.js, tools/fixtures/field/node/stubs.js. Screenshots are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-others/00503990-4adc-574c-b37a-87d13f1cb58c/scratchpad/a4/ (list below).
done: Party on the field: the caterpillar is 1 to 4 bodies and follows the party size live (recruit or swap mid-map). Sprites use R.Party.spriteKey. Whole-tile 8-direction movement (STEP = 1) is kept; nobody steps in place while standing (party or NPCs). Map-name banner follows 11.6.2.

A full inventory keeps the chest shut and it shows the same contents next time. p_rare chests use obj:chest_rare; the jingle and the star mark follow the item grade. Random battles: R.Game.encItem replaces the old repel code. 誘い寄せ doubles the rate. 魔除け (weakOnly) skips a battle only when the living party's average level is at least the zone's Lb + 3. Running out of steps shows the STYLE_JA line plus the cancel sound. encounterPct is capped at plus or minus 50. No battle in the first 6 steps after a battle or entering a map. The map lvOff is passed to R.Battle.start.
Damage floors take damagePct of max HP and never go below 1 HP; noFloorDamage protects only the member who has it (DESIGN 3.3.10-10).

requests.what: Add enterDark: '!pro_start' to the roa_house map.

requests.what: Don't play extra sounds around R.Field.teleport or R.Field.exitDungeon (they already play quill then teleport, and bell then warp). Apply the encounter effect with R.Field.setEncItem({id, pct, steps, weakOnly}); R.Field.repel still works but is legacy. Keep calling R.Field.respawn() from GameOver.run, not Field.warp. For 隠し通路 n/総数 use R.Field.secretsFound() and R.FieldMap.secretTotal().
requests.why: Avoids doubled sounds and stale field modifiers. Calling respawn keeps the town onEnter held back until the game-over sequence ends; W4 passes with the current gameover.js.

requests.what: Give secret_forest and secret_rock a found look based on R.Game.secrets (key 'mapId:x,y'); the field clears the world cell cache when one is found.

requests.what: Register the story_rumor event (lute and roa already use it). ev.clearRegion plays the whole chapter scene and gives the page; don't give the page separately. ev.caption accepts {frames, pos, size:16, highlight}.

I reviewed A9 (weapons) against DESIGN §8/§9.12, STYLE_JA and BRIEF Part A–A7, and it now passes with 0 failures and 0 warnings. All 301 weapons are present and match the tables: 120 normal, 59 band rare, 10 hand-made super, 31 monster rare, 79 monster super and 2 fixed-tier super.

The implementer's work was largely correct. I fixed three things:
1. Load order (§1.2-2). The data files depended on items_weapons_common.js loading first. That only works under localeCompare; with a plain .sort(), items_weapons.js loads first and crashes. I removed the 5th file and went back to the 4 files §8.1.4 lists. Each file now registers its weapons at load time using only its own code, and the shared finishing kit in items_weapons.js is only called from R.onData. test_weapons.js now loads the files in three different orders and checks that all 301 weapons come out identical.
2. Names. STYLE_JA §2 says 珊瑚 is written サンゴ, and STYLE_JA is the authority on names, so w_spear_coral and w_staff_sr_coralwand are now サンゴの槍 and サンゴの杖. check_weapons.js records this as an allowed difference from the DESIGN tables.
3. Generated descriptions. When a description does not fit, the generator now shortens an effect sentence before the 「ただし〜」 trade-off sentence, as the §8.6.5 and §8.7.2 tables do. Only two descriptions changed (大蛇の皮鞭, 雪男の大こぶし).
